IV. DATA AND DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
 Earnings Opacity Measures
 The data used in constructing the earnings opacity variables come from th
 database for the years 1984 through 1998. We restrict the sample to industr
 codes 2000-3999 and SIC codes 5000-5999) to increase the homogeneity o
 across countries and across time. Since the underlying earnings process being
 by accounting earnings is similar for industrial firms, this restriction reduces th
 that the cross-country differences and time-differences we observe in our ea
 measures are caused by the difference in or changes in industrial composition 
 This sample restriction is also consistent with much of the accounting literature (
 et al. 1993; Ali and Hwang 2000)." Because all our tests are panel data tests,

 and amortization expense, operating income, net income, and total assets. S
 not have information on income taxes payable or on the current portion of l
